title: Skin Care for a Rajasthan Desert Trip: Pack, Protect, Moisturise
ex: Sunny days, cold nights, sand and very dry air: what to pack for Jaisalmer or Bikaner and a simple daily routine for desert skin.
rt: Skin Care for a Rajasthan Desert Trip | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for a Rajasthan desert trip: what to pack for Jaisalmer, sunscreen and sand tips for camel safaris, and a richer night routine for cold, dry nights.
keyword: skin care for rajasthan desert trip
quick: In the Rajasthan desert, use SPF 30+ sunscreen every morning and reapply it outdoors, cover your face with a scarf on safaris, and rinse sand off instead of rubbing. At night, use a richer moisturiser on slightly damp skin, plus lip balm and hand cream.
facts: Desert days are sunny while nights can be very cold
Pale sand reflects sunlight onto the face
Moisturise on slightly damp skin in dry air
Rinse sand off with water instead of rubbing
